REVISE

- **Preset color mismatch on bgCard**: The visual spec declares "card bg `#1e1830`", but the `bgCard` semantic token in preset.ts resolves to `{colors.neutral.800}` = `#292236`. These are different colors. Either add `#1e1830` as a discrete color token and point bgCard to it, or clarify in the visual spec that cards use `#292236` (neutral.800). As written now, a card component will render in the wrong color.
